$comment: Every design of the site. scripts/release.mjs serves the current one at /, builds every other at its path (/v1/ with Jekyll and its _config.<id>.yml, /v3/ with Astro and SITE_THEME=<id>) and points /classic/ and /prev/ at the older ones; /versions/ lists them and [ and ] step one design back and forward. Previews ({id, name, url, ...}) live on their own hosts and /<id>/ forwards there. To retire the current design: set its path to /<id>/, give the new one path / and point current at it.

versions.name: Classic
versions.stack: Jekyll and Bootstrap 3, forked from Hux Blog
versions.line: A big photograph over every post, the posts in one column, and a switch between Chinese and English on the pages written in both.

versions.name: Palette
versions.line: Code, theatre and writing side by side, the production photographs at full size, and one accent colour picked for each visit.

versions.name: Maian
versions.stack: Astro, its own pages (src-maian/), the same posts
versions.line: Painted in the manner of microsoft.ai: bands of butter, apricot and slate brushed live in WebGL, a serif over a quiet sans, and every photograph in full.
